question.text: According to Freundlich adsorption isotherm, which of the following is correct ?

options.text: All the above are correct for different ranges of pressure

solution.text:
$\frac{\mathrm{x}}{\mathrm{m}} \propto \mathrm{P}^0$ is true at extremely high pressures
$\frac{x}{m} \propto p^1 ; \frac{x}{m} \propto p^{1 / n}$ are true at low and moderate pressures.
